FIR Filed After Prayagraj Temple Wall Collapse During Excavation

An FIR has been registered against three individuals in Prayagraj following the collapse of a wall at the Swaminarayan temple. The incident occurred during excavation work for a hotel basement. The FIR cites alleged negligence as the cause of the collapse. No casualties were reported in the incident.
